name: hmsi
description: Hospital Management System - Multi-platform (Web / Windows / Android)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -c auto -n api,web "npm run dev -w @hmsi/api" "npm run dev -w @hmsi/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w web
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build && npm run build -w @hmsi/api
